verses.text: Do ye indeed speak righteousness, O congregation? do ye judge uprightly, O ye sons of men?

segments.text: Do ye indeed speak righteousness, O congregation? do ye judge uprightly, O ye sons of men?

verses.text: Yea, in heart ye work wickedness; ye weigh the violence of your hands in the earth.

segments.text: Yea, in heart ye work wickedness; ye weigh the violence of your hands in the earth.

verses.text: The wicked are estranged from the womb: they go astray as soon as they be born, speaking lies.

segments.text: The wicked are estranged from the womb: they go astray as soon as they be born, speaking lies.

notes: 58.3 as soon…: Heb. from the belly

verses.text: Their poison is like the poison of a serpent: they are like the deaf adder that stoppeth her ear;

segments.text: like the poison of a serpent:

notes: 58.4 like the poison: Heb. according to the likeness, etc

verses.text: Which will not hearken to the voice of charmers, charming never so wisely.

segments.text: Which will not hearken to the voice of charmers, charming never so wisely.

notes: 58.5 charming…: or, be the charmer never so cunning

verses.text: Break their teeth, O God, in their mouth: break out the great teeth of the young lions, O LORD.

segments.text: Break their teeth, O God, in their mouth: break out the great teeth of the young lions, O LORD.

verses.text: Let them melt away as waters which run continually: when he bendeth his bow to shoot his arrows, let them be as cut in pieces.

segments.text: Let them melt away as waters
his arrows, let them be as cut in pieces.

verses.text: As a snail which melteth, let every one of them pass away: like the untimely birth of a woman, that they may not see the sun.

segments.text: the untimely birth of a woman,
they may not see the sun.

verses.text: Before your pots can feel the thorns, he shall take them away as with a whirlwind, both living, and in his wrath.

segments.text: Before your pots can feel the thorns, he shall take them away as with a whirlwind, both living, and in

notes: 58.9 both…: Heb. as living as wrath

verses.text: The righteous shall rejoice when he seeth the vengeance: he shall wash his feet in the blood of the wicked.

segments.text: The righteous shall rejoice when he seeth the vengeance: he shall wash his feet in the blood of the wicked.

verses.text: So that a man shall say, Verily there is a reward for the righteous: verily he is a God that judgeth in the earth.

segments.text: So that a man shall say, Verily
a reward for the righteous: verily he is a God that judgeth in the earth.

notes: 58.11 a reward…: Heb. fruit of the, etc

headings.text: To the chief Musician, Al-taschith, Michtam of David.
